name: p3-volatile-pointee-baseline
text:
extern int far handle; extern void far consume(int);
{{FORM}}

FORM.pointer_field_ordinary: void far f(void) { struct { int far *p; } h; h.p = &handle; if (*h.p != 0) { consume(*h.p); *h.p = 0; } }
FORM.pointer_field_volatile_pointee: void far f(void) { struct { volatile int far *p; } h; h.p = &handle; if (*h.p != 0) { consume(*h.p); *h.p = 0; } }
FORM.local_volatile_pointee: void far f(void) { volatile int far *p; p = &handle; if (*p != 0) { consume(*p); *p = 0; } }
